answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The cipher of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The oasis lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quartz is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
